title: Imagine’s generated-text controls stopped freelancing
summary:
A small garden-maintenance day: steadier Imagine controls, cleaner streaming behavior, and another community project in the directory.

The Imagine interface got a fix for the text-generated button behaving unpredictably, making the creation flow less adventurous than intended.

The response delivery path was updated so streaming output and p-ads markers are handled consistently instead of taking separate, slightly mysterious routes.

Echo AI joined the community project list, while the Mistral model backend moved from Cloudflare to Scaleway.
